text_block_list.text: (Screeech!)

The day to depart for Europe has arrived. 
In pursuit of conquering an overseas GⅠ, 
I'll first test my skills in an accessible 
race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, guess we're saying goodbye to this 
country until autumn, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's bring home a massive souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's roll!!
(Creeeeak!!)
choice_data_list: I thought I just heard a strange noise...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I did it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I messed up. When I did that cool turn, my 
ankle went crunch.
(Wee-woo wee-woo...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you completely and utterly 
STUUUUPID?!!!!!!!!!

Her voice was loud enough to pierce right 
through the ceiling of the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Talking such a big game, dragging me in as 
her roommate, and causing such a massive 
uproar!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet, it wasn't even during 
training—spraining your ankle at the 
airport is completely absurd!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah, my bad. I'm sooorry, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Things like that happen. Touring ain't 
always clear skies, you know."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Like I'd know! So, what are we doing next?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As for that part... my Trainer took care 
of it.
choice_data_list: For now, the trip is canceled.
For now, the trip is canceled.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yep. Well, it can't be helped, right?

"We'll just have to rest for a few days 
and reset our sights on autumn."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still... for me personally, maybe it 
turned out to be a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you go abroad just like this and by 
some chance don't come back, it'd leave a 
bad taste in my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Incomplete?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. When you said you were 
going for the Derby, I thought to myself, 
'What a half-baked guy.'

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd tell them I'd never want an opponent 
like this. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run in the Derby made me 
realize something. I lost to sheer 
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You'd need an extraordinarily strong 
resolve to do something like that. I was 
simply left at a loss for words...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Didn't you say you weren't gonna 
watch the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I said it, alright! But I ended up 
watching it! Because I was bored! On TV!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I just knew... we absolutely had 
to finish what we couldn't at the Oaks 
together..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, okay? Hurry up and get that 
injury healed. You're tough anyway, so 
you'll be fine in no time, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
While you're stumbling around, I'm gonna 
get stronger! So strong that you'll 
absolutely want to run with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me this autumn. I won't let you 
get away this time. No, I won't even make 
you want to run away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And the winner's gonna be me. Be prepared 
for that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...All right, fine. But I can't even 
predict myself, so no telling how it'll 
turn out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, I'll run for ya.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I made a promise, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright. You're sleeping here tonight, 
right? Go to bed soon. I'll tidy up your 
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what a loudmouthed guy. 
Though... maybe I caused some trouble for 
them.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Trainer. You went through all the 
trouble of getting ready, and now 
everything's a mess.
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it, it's fun and I never 
get tired of it.

Don't worry about it, I never get bored of 
it—it's fun!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, seriously, you're one awesome 
partner. Totally different from that other 
guy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, guess I'll wallow in my own 
patheticness and sleep tonight. The rain's 
gotta stop eventually anyway..."
